skill.name: video-edit
skill.description: Route video edit requests to the appropriate RunComfy model for restyling, background swaps, packaging changes, motion transfer, and outfit edits.
skill.summary: Selects the right RunComfy video edit model and formats the request for reliable edits.
skill.author: agentspace-so

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown backticks, placeholder URLs, and ellipses in examples. The confirmed risks are intended RunComfy CLI execution, outbound processing through RunComfy services, and local token storage for authentication.

remediation.issue: The skill depends on installing and running a third-party CLI.
remediation.suggestion: Tell users to review the RunComfy CLI package source and permissions before installing it globally, and prefer pinned versions in controlled environments.

remediation.issue: Video, image, prompts, and generated outputs are processed through RunComfy services.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user approval before sending private, regulated, or unreleased media to the external service.

remediation.issue: Authentication tokens may be stored in a hidden file under the user home directory.
remediation.suggestion: Keep token files owner-only, document token revocation, and recommend RUNCOMFY_TOKEN for ephemeral CI environments.

content.value_statement: Choosing the right video edit model is hard when each model has different strengths. This skill routes the request to Wan, Kling, or Lucy and prepares model-specific prompts.
actual_capabilities: Routes general restyle, background swap, and packaging edits to Wan 2.7 Edit-Video.
Routes motion transfer requests to Kling 2.6 Pro Motion Control.
Routes lightweight outfit and lighting edits to Lucy Edit Restyle.
Provides model-specific input fields, limits, and example RunComfy CLI calls.
Includes prompting guidance for identity, motion, audio, and framing preservation.
limitations: Requires the RunComfy CLI, an account, and valid authentication.
Uploads or references user media through the RunComfy service.
Each route inherits model limits for duration, resolution, and aspect ratio.
The skill selects one route per request and does not blend models.

use_cases.title: Restyle social video clips
use_cases.description: Change background, lighting, or visual style while preserving face, pose, motion, and audio.

use_cases.title: Update product visuals
use_cases.description: Replace packaging or product presentation in short clips using a reference image and controlled prompt.

use_cases.title: Transfer character motion
use_cases.description: Map movement from a reference video onto a target character with identity preservation.

prompt_templates.title: Basic background edit
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a simple talking-head change.
prompt_templates.prompt: Edit this video so the person keeps the same face, pose, lip movement, and audio. Change only the background to a clean modern office.

prompt_templates.title: Product packaging replacement
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request with a source video and reference image.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the reference image to replace the package design in the video. Preserve hand movement, camera framing, product size, and original audio.

prompt_templates.title: Motion transfer request
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request that needs motion from a reference clip.
prompt_templates.prompt: Transfer the dance motion from the reference video to the target character. Keep the character identity stable and preserve the reference audio.

prompt_templates.title: Route selection and constraints
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request asking the assistant to choose the best model.
prompt_templates.prompt: Choose the best RunComfy route for this edit. Explain the model choice, required inputs, duration limits, and the exact preservation goals before running it.

output_examples.input: Restyle a 6 second presenter video with a modern office background and keep the original voice.
output_examples.output: The skill selects Wan 2.7 Edit-Video, keeps original audio, and prepares a prompt that preserves face, pose, framing, and lip movement.

output_examples.input: Make this character follow the motion from a dance reference clip.
output_examples.output: The skill selects Kling 2.6 Pro Motion Control and asks for the target image or video, the motion reference, and orientation.

output_examples.input: Change the outfit in this walking video to professional business attire.
output_examples.output: The skill selects Lucy Edit Restyle for a localized outfit edit and keeps the prompt focused on face and motion preservation.

best_practices: State preservation goals before the requested visual change.
Use one edit direction per run to reduce motion drift.
Check model duration, resolution, and input type limits before running.
anti_patterns: Do not combine many unrelated edits in one prompt.
Do not use a reference image unless the edit needs visual transfer.
Do not send sensitive or private media without user approval.

faq.question: Does this skill edit video locally?
faq.answer: No. It uses the local RunComfy CLI to submit requests to RunComfy models.

faq.question: Which model is used by default?
faq.answer: Wan 2.7 Edit-Video is the default when the user does not specify a more focused route.

faq.question: Can it preserve the original audio?
faq.answer: Yes, supported routes include audio options such as preserving the original sound.

faq.question: Can it transfer motion from another video?
faq.answer: Yes. Motion transfer requests are routed to Kling 2.6 Pro Motion Control.

faq.question: Can it edit long videos?
faq.answer: Only within each model limit. The documented routes are intended for short clips.

faq.question: What inputs are required?
faq.answer: Most routes need a source video URL, a prompt, and sometimes a reference image or motion video.
